quick_260630_rn4_state.what: Add a transient-short-read RETRY GUARD to the native-plink LD loop's square-path window verify so a one-off .bim short read self-heals in-run instead of silently erroring a region.
quick_260630_rn4_state.design: Reusable _window_bim_n_var_retry_on_zero(bim_path, chrom, from_bp, to_bp, *, expect_nonzero, retries=_WINDOW_BIM_RETRIES=3, sleep_s=_WINDOW_BIM_RETRY_SLEEP_S=0.5): calls _window_bim_n_var once; if n_var==0 AND expect_nonzero, re-reads up to `retries` times (small sleep); a recovery (>0) emits a LOUD WARN to stderr (visible in run log) and returns the real count. In process_region SQUARE path: compute bin_n_var FIRST, then call the wrapper with expect_nonzero=(bin_n_var>0); the existing `if bin_n_var != window_n_var: raise ValueError(...)` is BYTE-IDENTICAL (a persistent 0 still raises -> status=error -> loop continues; no semantics change). Banded path, resume skip/continue, content_verify_npz, OOM-bounded checks all UNTOUCHED.
